blocks.text: Singaporean artist Iman Fandi releases her debut EP “Afterglow” on 25 September 2026 across all major streaming platforms, the culmination of a breakout year and her most significant work yet as an independent artist. “Afterglow” is a story of finding yourself again, discovering confidence, embracing ambition and learning to put yourself first. Across the EP, Iman steps into her own light, leaves behind what no longer serves her and embraces a bolder, more unapologetic version of herself.
